About

Three years of orders, inventory and reports

I'm an MIS and E-Commerce specialist based in New Delhi, currently handling catalog and backend operations at IN Time Garments. Across three roles I've managed order volumes from 50 to 2,000+ a day, kept inventory accurate across lakhs of SKUs, and built the daily reports that let operations teams make calls with confidence instead of guesswork.

Outside work, I hold an MA in Islamic Studies from Jamia Millia Islamia and I'm currently pursuing a second Master's in Philosophy from IGNOU. On the side, I run my own labels on Meesho — Aliya Adornments and AL-ABEDIN COLLACTION — the operator in me doesn't really switch off.
